launch_mode: container exec --detach (process runs inside qlib-run; no host-side supervisor)

engine.note: new v1.4.0-semantics B v2 engine (pinned-pair walk-forward); the archived operator-stopped B v1 runner was not reused

instantiated_specs.counts_check: runtime/strategy_b_v2_counts.py: cohorts=20 strategy=120 dca=48 base_per_cohort=5760 per_grid=115200 total=1152000 fingerprint=MATCH ok=True

incident_u1.root_cause: run_cohort passed cohort.day_index (a per-BAR day number array) where the walk-forward step segments need cohort.day_start (the per-DAY first-bar index); the 5m/15m cohorts then had empty training segments, so every case was empty (n_steps=0, net_pnl=0)
incident_u1.detection: launcher read the live grid CSVs + runner log ~2 minutes after launch; the run was stopped before the container published any sentinel
incident_u1.partial_artifacts: the u1 attempt's artifacts/grid_*.csv, progress.json and state.json are INVALID partial output and must never be read as evidence
incident_u1.remediation: same round, new run u2 with engine sha256 sha256:940768c3d5bed836a16a006170771f36a21644fec8e59ade1e2b44aca68edd85; hypothesis, domains, split, gates and DCA rail unchanged (contract 8)

observed_after_launch_u2.live_csv_sanity: artifacts/grid_historical.csv: 1154 rows, 1154 with n_steps>0 (5m cohort) at ~30s after the cohort started
observed_after_launch_u2.measured_pace: ~38 rows/s; 1,152,000 rows total -> ~8-9 h wall time
observed_after_launch_u2.registered_estimate: round-spec expected.runtime_expectation: ~4.2 h (extrapolated from the Strategy A v2 per-case cost)
observed_after_launch_u2.discrepancy_note: a B v2 case is a walk-forward case (per-step training selection over the 30 pairs + the pinned test execution), measured at ~0.1 s per case vs the A engine's 12.6 ms per case on real data; the registered estimate is a preregistered estimate, not a promise, and this run's measured projection is reported instead

card_transition: card parked to 'scheduled' right after the launch (contract 9.2 step 5); the sentinel-based reconciler cron f6b9aa5e9034 stays PAUSED, so the operator must release the card (or resume the reconciler) once attempts/<run_id>/DONE appears
note: container writes result.json + artifacts/ + state.json + logs/; the terminal sentinel is published host-side via runtime/terminal_evidence.py. The card owns the round verdict.json + survivor bundle after the sentinel lands.
